page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.8xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, it provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256 GiB of system memory. This establishes a vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 1:8 (8 GiB per vCPU), targeting workloads where system memory requirements scale faster than compute demands.

Network performance features a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support continuous inter-node and database communication. The instance does not include bundled local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators such as GPUs. All storage capabilities must be supplied via external network-attached block storage devices.

By delivering high memory density per vCPU, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for software platforms that are constrained by memory capacity rather than raw compute or storage throughput. The ecs.r6.8xlarge is suitable for enterprise applications, including large in-memory databases, caching layers, real-time data analytics engines, and memory-intensive batch processing pipelines.
